batches.clinical_rationale: High-volume spinal injection procedures sharing core injection delivery mechanics, fluoroscopic guidance standards, numeric pain scales (>= 6/10), and conservative therapy duration modeling (2 weeks acute vs 6 weeks chronic vs 12 weeks pump trial). Establishing these parameters first creates the foundation for all subsequent IPM rules with minimal cross-rule entanglement.

pathways.description: Acute neck or back pain with radicular symptoms, duration < 3 months, failed >= 2 weeks conservative therapy, pain >= 6/10 or disability, fluoroscopic guidance.

Spinal stenosis on imaging causing axial or radicular pain, failed >= 6 weeks conservative therapy in prior 6 months (or ongoing if prior injection), pain >= 6/10 or disability, fluoroscopic guidance.

FBSS or epidural fibrosis causing axial or radicular pain, medical reason why injection needed, failed >= 6 weeks conservative therapy in prior 6 months (or ongoing), pain >= 6/10 or disability, fluoroscopic guidance.
Transforaminal injection for surgical planning, documented pre-operative evaluation and surgical plan, <= 2 levels per day, pain >= 6/10 or disability, fluoroscopic guidance.

test_matrix.description: Acute radicular back pain with 6 weeks duration (< 3m), failed 2 weeks conservative therapy, pain score 7/10, fluoroscopy.
Lumbar spinal stenosis causing radicular pain, failed 6 weeks conservative therapy in last 6 months, pain score 8/10, fluoroscopy.
Failed back surgery syndrome with epidural fibrosis causing radicular pain, documented medical reason for injection, failed 6 weeks conservative care, pain 6/10, fluoroscopy.
Pre-operative surgical planning TFESI at single level (L5-S1) with documented surgical plan, pain 7/10, fluoroscopy.
Non-radicular axial back pain without spinal stenosis or FBSS, failed conservative therapy.
Acute radicular pain but mild intensity (pain score 3/10, no functional disability).
Acute radicular pain with only 1 week of conservative treatment (< 2 weeks minimum).
Stenosis with conservative care documented, but pain intensity and functional disability missing.

pathways.description: Chronic intractable pain in non-terminal individual, pain >= 6/10 or disability, failed >= 12 weeks conservative therapy, not opioid-naive, trial count <= 2.

Intractable spasticity in non-terminal individual due to SCI, MS, Stiff Person, or other etiology causing inability to maintain upright posture, impaired ambulation, or ADL interference; failed >= 12 weeks conservative therapy; trial count <= 2.
Second trial indicated when first trial had < 50% relief or intolerable side effects, trial count == 2.

test_matrix.description: Chronic intractable back/leg pain, non-terminal, pain score 8/10, failed 14 weeks conservative care, on chronic opioids (not opioid-naive), trial 1.
Intractable spasticity secondary to multiple sclerosis, impaired balance in ambulation, failed 16 weeks oral antispasmodics and physical therapy, non-terminal, trial 1.
Second trial requested after first trial produced only 30% pain relief (< 50%).
Intractable pain meeting conservative care, but patient is opioid-naive.
Intractable pain with only 6 weeks of conservative therapy (< 12 weeks required).
Third trial requested (exceeds limit of two trials).

pathways.description: Axial low back pain below L5, duration >= 3 months, pain >= 6/10 or disability, cluster of >= 3 of 8 provocative physical exam findings, failed >= 6 weeks conservative therapy in last 6 months, imaging guidance.

Spondyloarthropathy with low back pain >= 3 months, age of onset < 45 years, comprehensive pain management program in place, imaging evidence of sacroiliitis, >= 1 spondyloarthropathy feature, imaging guidance.
Contrast-enhanced intra-articular injection for SIJ surgical planning, documented pre-op plan, relief >= 75% for expected duration, diagnostic count <= 2.

test_matrix.description: Axial pain below L5 for 5 months, pain score 7/10, 3 positive provocative tests (FABER, distraction, compression), failed 6 weeks conservative therapy, fluoroscopy.
Spondyloarthropathy with onset age 32 (< 45), back pain for 6 months, active sacroiliitis on MRI, positive HLA-B27, comprehensive pain program active, fluoroscopy.
Diagnostic SIJ injection for planned SI joint fusion, contrast-enhanced IA injection, 80% relief (>= 75%), trial 1, fluoroscopy.
Axial pain below L5, but only 2 provocative physical exam findings positive (< 3 required).
Axial pain below L5 with 3 positive tests, but pain duration only 6 weeks (< 3 months).
Sacroiliac joint injection requested without imaging guidance.

batches.clinical_rationale: Direct procedural continuum between diagnostic facet blocks and therapeutic denervation (RFA), enforcing the verified >= 70% MBB relief threshold. Sympathetic nerve blocks share diagnostic-to-neurolysis evaluation workflows and identical >= 50% anesthetic relief thresholds.

Radicular pain due to stenosis caused by facet synovial cyst confirmed on imaging, pain >= 6/10 or disability, failed >= 6 weeks conservative care, imaging guidance.
Chronic lumbar spondylolysis with pars interarticularis defect confirmed on imaging, pain >= 6/10 or disability, failed >= 6 weeks conservative therapy, imaging guidance.

test_matrix.description: Axial lumbar pain for 6 months, pain score 7/10, primary discogenic/SIJ excluded, failed 6 weeks conservative therapy, fluoroscopy.
Radicular pain secondary to lumbar facet synovial cyst confirmed on MRI, failed 6 weeks conservative care, fluoroscopy.
Primary radiculitis from disc herniation without synovial cyst.
Axial facet pain for only 4 weeks (< 3 months).

pathways.description: Axial pain >= 3 months, pain >= 6/10 or disability, positive response to diagnostic medial branch blocks with >= 70% relief, return of pain, not SIJ/discogenic/radicular, failed >= 6 weeks conservative care, fluoroscopy/CT.
Positive response to prior RFA with >= 50% relief for >= 4 months, continued pain >= 6/10 or disability, ongoing conservative care, <= 2 RFA procedures per 12 months, fluoroscopy/CT.

test_matrix.description: Initial lumbar RFA, axial pain 6 months, diagnostic MBB provided 80% relief (>= 70%), pain returned, failed 6 weeks conservative therapy, fluoroscopy.
Repeat RFA, prior RFA provided 60% relief (>= 50%) lasting 5 months (>= 4m), pain returned (score 7/10), 1 prior RFA in 12 months, fluoroscopy.
Initial RFA requested but prior diagnostic MBB relief was only 50% (< 70% required for initial RFA).
Repeat RFA requested, but prior RFA relief lasted only 2.5 months (< 4 months required).

pathways.description: Documented positive pain relief from prior diagnostic medial branch block >= 70%.
Documented positive pain relief from prior RFA >= 50% for duration >= 4 months.

test_matrix.description: Diagnostic MBB relief is 75% (>= 70%).
Diagnostic MBB relief is 65% (< 70%).
Repeat RFA relief is 55% (>= 50%) for 6 months (>= 4m).
Repeat RFA relief is 55% (>= 50%) but lasted only 3 months (< 4m).

pathways.description: CPT 64510, pain >= 6/10 or cancer pain, image-guided, acute zoster (< 4w + antiviral) or cancer/phantom limb (failed conservative) or CRPS (failed functional restoration), unilateral.
CPT 64520, pain >= 6/10 or cancer pain, fluoro/CT (no US), acute zoster or cancer/phantom/ischemic limb (failed conservative) or CRPS (failed functional restoration), unilateral.
CPT 64530, upper abdominal cancer pain (conservative therapy not required) or chronic pancreatitis (failed conservative therapy), image-guided.
CPT 64517, pelvic/rectal cancer pain (conservative therapy not required) or chronic noncancer visceral pelvic pain (failed conservative care), fluoro/CT guided.

test_matrix.description: Stellate ganglion block (64510) for acute shingles with pain for 2 weeks (< 4w), on valacyclovir, pain score 7/10, unilateral, image-guided.
Lumbar sympathetic block (64520) for nonsurgical ischemic limb pain, pain 8/10, failed conservative medical care, fluoroscopy.
Celiac plexus block (64530) for pancreatic cancer upper abdominal pain (conservative therapy waived), image-guided.
Bilateral stellate ganglion blocks requested on same day of service (prohibited).
Stellate ganglion block for herpes zoster with pain duration 6 weeks (> 4 weeks).

batches.clinical_rationale: High-complexity systemic clinical evaluations. Spinal cord stimulation requires full 4-element psychiatric clearance, MRSA/MSSA infection decolonization protocols, and multi-etiology branches. EPOS 1755 spans systemic multi-organ comorbidity criteria across the entire IPM procedure catalog.

Lower limb CRPS Type I or II meeting Budapest criteria, pain duration >= 6 months, pain >= 6/10 or disability, failed >= 6 months conservative therapy, completed presurgical psychological assessment (all 4 elements cleared).

test_matrix.description: Failed back surgery syndrome with intractable leg pain for 12 months, pain 8/10, failed 8 months conservative therapy, all 4 psych criteria satisfied, staph decolonization plan active.
DRGS trial for lower limb CRPS type I meeting Budapest criteria, pain 7/10, duration 9 months, failed conservative care, psych cleared.
SCS candidate with active untreated substance use disorder / psych clearance not met.
Neuropathic back/leg pain for only 3 months (< 6 months).

pathways.description: ASA Physical Status score >= 3.
Body Mass Index (BMI) >= 40 (with or without obesity-related conditions).
Severe cardiac problems (prior surgery, MI, HF, CAD/stents, arrhythmia, pacemaker/ICD) or lung problems (COPD, asthma).
Chronic kidney or liver problems, blood clots or bleeding disorders, stroke/TIA.

Hypertension requiring 3+ drugs, poorly controlled diabetes, cognitive impairment, pregnancy, active substance use disorder, prior anesthesia complications, difficult airway, sleep apnea, anaphylaxis.

test_matrix.description: Patient with ASA physical status score 3 requested in outpatient hospital setting.
Patient with BMI 42.1 (>= 40) requested in hospital setting.
Patient with history of coronary artery disease with stent and arrhythmia.
Patient with severe diagnosed sleep apnea.
Healthy patient (ASA 1, BMI 25, no comorbidities) requested in outpatient hospital setting.
